newsitem.title: UK: Brent crude system Jan throughput slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude system Jan throughput slightly lower.

text.p: Brent system operator Shell Exploration and Production (Shell Expro) on Friday estimated North Sea Brent crude system throughput in December at 520,745 barrels per day (bpd), slightly down from 539,788 bpd in December.
Average Brent pipeline throughput for the year to the end of November was 482,994 bpd, Shell said.
Shell Expro is a joint venture between Royal Dutch/Shell Group and Exxon Corp.

Brent system throughput includes crude produced from 13 fields and several satellite wells piped to the Sullom Voe terminal in the Shetland Islands for blending with Ninian crude and exported as Brent Blend.
Shell Expro said the throughput forecast was preliminary and may be "subject to significant fluctuation".
